actual_bond_attention_study_20261027.comparison: Same sealed old predictions and labels. Equal arithmetic mean of T+1/T+14/T+30 MAEs strictly lower in both TSCV and fixed2026, with no loss of finite coverage. No extra bp threshold. Report all horizon MAE/RMSE/bias/hit5 and all failures.
